title: [CertiK｜中心化风险｜OTA-13][audit-fix] 治理角色集中化
description:
## 来源与修复范围

来源：[CertiK TSV 初审报告（原始 PDF）](https://gitlab.okg.com/web3-dex/tsv/uploads/4b71892b28b1a3f8a9851a862d66ee15/CertiK-PRE-OKX-TSV---Audit__preliminary-20261030T231203Z.pdf)，第 10,11,12,13,14,15 页，编号 **OTA-13**，原报告等级 **Centralization**。原报告状态为 Pending；以下状态是 2026-10-31 独立代码复核结论，不代表 CertiK 已确认关闭。

**修复目标分支：`audit/2026-10-27-6402443-fix`（audit-fix）。请本项单独提交修复/验证记录，建立对应 MR，不与其他审计项混成一个不可独立验收的变更。**

- 报告审计 commit：`85623cd73ab6248b4acec71f478f30088c4deec3`。
- audit-fix 复核 commit：`543dcd34e882eead3a9f2391540c704105fbc693`。
- main 对照 commit：`a8bfc93aa2cf40142e6511e5069d90f65b59f420`；本 Issue 的修复目标是 audit-fix。

## 双基线复核

- **audit-fix：仍存在：治理信任模型**
- **main：仍存在：治理信任模型**

报告描述成立，但这是管理权限带来的信任边界，不能直接等同于无权限漏洞。

### 原因与实现

Registry 以 DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE 管理角色；SYMBOL_ADMIN 控制资产准入、证券和池状态等；VOLUME_ORACLE 可调整额度/用量；FORCE_EXIT_ADMIN 可强退。初始化把默认管理与升级权限同时授予初始管理员。

### 影响与利用前提

需要管理员被攻破、误操作或主动滥用权限。main 另有暂停期间更换 PermissionsAdapterFactory 的治理入口，授权能力比 audit-fix 更广。报告中的角色列表还需区分常量与实际权限：REVOKE_EXIT_EXECUTOR_ROLE、WITHDRAW_CLAIM_ROLE 仅定义，并不代表当前存在相应提款通道。不能据此认定任何 EOA 都能提走资产。

## audit-fix 处理要求与验收条件

- [ ] 建立默认管理、升级、资产准入、额度、应急、强退权限矩阵，区分实际使用权限与仅声明的角色常量。
- [ ] 提供最小授权的部署/治理操作清单与参数校验，关键管理和升级权限采用多签治理；应急权限保留独立的快速响应路径。
- [ ] 明确 Factory/发行方权限及每项高权限操作的资产影响；增加角色配置核验和治理操作留痕说明。
- [ ] 在本 Issue 记录最终处理、对应 MR/完整 commit、验证命令与结果，并提供供 CertiK 复核的证据；已修复项以复核和回归补全验收，不制造无意义的重复代码改动。

### 修复建议及注意事项

保留业务必需角色；默认管理与升级使用多签，按职责拆分准入、额度、应急和强退权限，记录角色变更和操作理由。是否加 timelock 应考虑暂停/应急响应速度。不要通过盲目 renounce 管理权来消除报告项。代码复核不能证明现网已采用多签或权限已安全分配。

## 已有验证与边界

静态调用链复核；未执行该项动态攻击 PoC。

本次为报告逐项复核，未发送生产交易；mock 边界测试不代表完整端到端攻击或现网资产/角色配置已经确认。

相关既有审计记录：#13。本单保留 CertiK 原始编号与单独验收要求。

  Recommendation

The finding reflects the current project design and may require iterative improvements to operational security and
decentralization. In most cases, these risks cannot be fully resolved at the present stage. We advise the client to securely
manage the private keys associated with privileged accounts to reduce the risk of compromise. In general, we strongly

[PDF page 15]
OTA-13     OKX TSV - AUDIT




recommend that centralized privileges or roles be managed through decentralized mechanisms or secure smart-contract-
based accounts, such as multisignature wallets.

The following are feasible measures that may mitigate these risks in the short and long term or, where applicable,
permanently resolve them:


Short Term:

Timelock and Multi sign (⅔, ⅗) combination mitigate by delaying the sensitive operation and avoiding a single point of key
management failure.

   Time-lock with reasonable latency, e.g., 48 hours, for awareness on privileged operations;
   AND

   Assignment of privileged roles to multi-signature wallets to prevent a single point of failure due to the private key
   compromised;
   AND

   A medium/blog link for sharing the timelock contract and multi-signers addresses information with the public
   audience.


Long Term:

Timelock and DAO, the combination, mitigate by applying decentralization and transparency.

   Time-lock with reasonable latency, e.g., 48 hours, for awareness on privileged operations;
   AND

   Introduction of a DAO/governance/voting module to increase transparency and user involvement.
   AND

   A medium/blog link for sharing the timelock contract, multi-signers addresses, and DAO information with the public
   audience.


Permanent:

Renouncing the ownership or removing the function can be considered fully resolved.

   Renounce the ownership and never claim back the privileged roles.
   OR

   Remove the risky functionality.
